message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—steady traffic, no major detours, and staying within speed limits—you’d expect about **6 hours** of driving time. If you’re heading during rush hour or on weekends, traffic can add an extra hour or two, so plan for **7–8 hours** to be safe.
